# Sal’s Tire Shop

> Used tires and tire service in Hartford, Connecticut.

Sal’s sells used tires only. Address: 631 Wethersfield Avenue, Hartford, Connecticut. Phone: (860) 713-8348. Open every day, 8 AM–6 PM, America/New_York. Call to confirm tire sizes, availability, prices, and total. There is no online ordering or appointment booking.

Services: used tires, plugs, wheel balancing, mounting and balancing, tire rotation, rim inner cleaning, regular valve service, and tire pressure sensor valve service.
